name: Ditto
tagline: A non-custodial trading and wallet-intelligence terminal with tamper-evident opBNB activity receipts.
description: Ditto brings market discovery, wallet intelligence, demo trading, and connected venue execution into one terminal. Demo actions create opBNB receipts through a unique mirror address for each user. After a supported venue confirms a real fill, Ditto can create a separately classified receipt that commits fill metadata and the action-time trading-equity snapshot. Receipts are activity attestations, not venue settlement. Users can also publish a competition score with their connected wallet.
